```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = TRUE,
  cache = FALSE,
  fig.width = 7,

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(emmeans)

# Save results in the Weed Biomass folder.
output_dir <- file.path(getwd(), "Weed Biomass")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Confirmed mowing schedule relative to broccoli transplanting:
# T2: 1 week before, and 3 and 6 weeks after transplanting.
# T3: 1 week before, and 6 weeks after transplanting.
# T4: 1 week before transplanting only.
#
# Treatments remain categorical factors in the statistical model.

treatment_levels <- c("T4", "T3", "T2")

treatment_labels <- c(
  T4 = "T4\n-1 week",
  T3 = "T3\n-1 and +6 weeks",
  T2 = "T2\n-1, +3 and +6 weeks"
)

treatment_colours <- c(
  T4 = "#A56A46",
  T3 = "#4B8395",
  T2 = "#4A8862"
)

locations <- c("Broccoli", "Cover crop")

save_csv <- function(x, filename) {
  write.csv(
    x,
    file.path(output_dir, filename),
    row.names = FALSE,
    na = ""
  )
}

show_table <- function(x, caption, digits = 4) {
  cat("\n\n")

  print(knitr::kable(
    x,
    caption = caption,
    digits = digits,
    row.names = FALSE
  ))

  cat("\n\n")
}

make_anova_table <- function(model) {
  a <- as.data.frame(anova(model))

  data.frame(
    Term = rownames(a),
    a,
    row.names = NULL,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

## Research question

How do mowing schedules affect total weed biomass at broccoli harvest,
and how do the planted treatments compare with the weedy control?

- **T1:** weedy control; no broccoli or cover crop planted.
- **T2:** mowing at 1 week before transplanting and at 3 and 6 weeks
  after transplanting.
- **T3:** mowing at 1 week before transplanting and at 6 weeks
  after transplanting.
- **T4:** mowing at 1 week before transplanting only.

Vegetation is assigned to three categories: weeds, volunteers and
sown cover crops. Total weed biomass includes identified and
unidentified weeds, including UNKNOWN MONOCOTS, UNKNOWN DICOTS and
UNKNOWN BRASSICA.

Volunteer clover and sown cover crops are reported separately and
excluded from total weed biomass.

TRFAL is displayed as Berseem clover. Existing CLOVER records retain
their previously confirmed meaning, Volunteer clover. RYE and
CEREAL RYE identify the sown rye cover crop. TRFRE retains its
existing classification as a weed.

## Sampling and statistical methods

The two sampling protocols are analysed separately:

- **Broccoli area:** T2-T4; two 0.28-square-metre quadrats per plot,
  cut at ground level.
- **Cover-crop area:** T2-T4; two 0.16-square-metre quadrats per plot,
  cut at 8 cm above ground.
- **T1:** four 0.16-square-metre quadrats per plot, cut at 8 cm,
  using the cover-crop-area protocol.

Weed masses are summed within each observed quadrat and divided
by quadrat area. Quadrat densities are averaged within each plot
and sampling location.

The plot is the experimental unit: 12 plot means for the Broccoli
area and 16 for the cover-crop area. Each model includes treatment
and block as categorical fixed effects.

Tukey adjustment is applied to all pairwise treatment comparisons
within each model: three pairs for the Broccoli area and six for
the cover-crop area.

T1 is shown separately as a descriptive reference in the Broccoli
report because its cutting height differs. It is excluded from
that model.

Comparisons among T2-T4 address mowing schedules. Comparisons with
T1 also reflect whether broccoli and cover crops were planted and
do not isolate a mowing effect.

## Import and prepare the data

```{r import-and-clean, include=FALSE}
# Output folder.
output_dir <- file.path(getwd(), "Weed Biomass")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Treatment order, labels and colours.
treatment_levels <- c("T1", "T4", "T3", "T2")

treatment_labels <- c(
  T1 = "T1\nWeedy control",
  T4 = "T4\n-1 week",
  T3 = "T3\n-1 and +6 weeks",
  T2 = "T2\n-1, +3 and +6 weeks"
)

treatment_colours <- c(
  T1 = "#777777",
  T4 = "#A56A46",
  T3 = "#4B8395",
  T2 = "#4A8862"
)

locations <- c("Broccoli", "Cover crop")

# Download the workbook from GitHub: 2-Data/Raw/.
github_url <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pr1nc3sso/",
  "Xilei-Living-cover-crop/master/2-Data/Raw/",
  "Vegetation%20survey%20-%20broccoli%20harvest.xlsx"
)

options(timeout = max(120, getOption("timeout", 60)))
excel_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx")

download.file(
  github_url,
  excel_file,
  mode = "wb",
  method = "libcurl",
  quiet = TRUE
)

raw <- read_excel(
  excel_file,
  sheet = "2026",
  range = cell_cols("A:J"),
  col_types = "text",
  trim_ws = FALSE
)

expected_headers <- c(
  "Biomass collection date",
  "Weeks after transplanting",
  "Block",
  "Treatment",
  "Quadrat",
  "Relative location to Broccoli: in row or in cover crop",
  "Species",
  "Biomass weight without bags, scale tared (gram)",
  "Quadrat size (m2)",
  "Weight date"
)

if (!identical(names(raw), expected_headers)) {
  stop("Excel headers changed. Check the column mapping.")
}

# Preserve source row numbers.
raw$excel_row <- seq_len(nrow(raw)) + 1L
raw <- raw[rowSums(!is.na(raw[1:10])) > 0, ]

# Remove only exact duplicates across the original ten columns.
duplicate_flag <- duplicated(as.data.frame(raw[1:10]))

save_csv(
  raw[duplicate_flag, ],
  "removed_exact_duplicates.csv"
)

clean <- raw[!duplicate_flag, ]

names(clean)[1:10] <- c(
  "collection_date",
  "weeks_after_transplanting",
  "block",
  "treatment",
  "quadrat",
  "location",
  "species",
  "weight_g",
  "source_area_m2",
  "weighing_date"
)

clean <- clean %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(block, treatment, quadrat, weight_g, source_area_m2),
      as.numeric
    ),
    source_location = location,
    source_species = species,
    location = trimws(gsub("[[:space:]]+", " ", location)),
    species = toupper(trimws(gsub("[[:space:]]+", " ", species))),
    species = recode(
      species,
      "UNKNOWNN MONOCOTS" = "UNKNOWN MONOCOTS",
      "UNKNOWNN DICOTS" = "UNKNOWN DICOTS"
    ),
    # All T1 quadrats follow the cover-crop-area sampling protocol.
    location = if_else(treatment == 1, "Cover crop", location)
  )

# Validate identifiers and weights.
numeric_fields <- c(
  "block", "treatment", "quadrat", "weight_g"
)

if (any(!is.finite(as.matrix(clean[numeric_fields])))) {
  stop("Missing or invalid identifiers or weights.")
}

if (any(clean$weight_g < 0)) {
  stop("Negative biomass weights.")
}

if (
  any(!clean$block %in% 1:4) ||
  any(!clean$treatment %in% 1:4) ||
  any(!clean$quadrat %in% 1:4) ||
  any(!clean$location %in% locations)
) {
  stop("Unexpected block, treatment, quadrat or location.")
}

if (any(is.na(clean$species) | clean$species == "")) {
  stop("Missing species labels.")
}

# Explicit classification of the currently recorded weed codes.
weed_species <- c(
  "AMARE", "ARTVU", "CAPBP", "CHEAL", "DIGIS", "DIGSA",
  "ECHCG", "GASCI", "LACSE", "MALNE", "MEDLU", "OXASD",
  "OXAST", "PLANA", "POLLA", "POLPE", "POROL", "SETSP",
  "SETPU", "SETVI", "TRFRE", "UNKNOWN MONOCOTS"
)
berseem_codes <- c("TRFAL", "BERSEEM CLOVER", "BERSEEM", "TRIFOLIUM ALEXANDRINUM")
rye_codes <- c("RYE", "CEREAL RYE", "SECALE CEREALE", "SECCE")
volunteer_codes <- c("CLOVER", "VOLUNTEER CLOVER")

analysis_records <- clean %>%
  mutate(
    area_m2 = if_else(location == "Broccoli", 0.28, 0.16),
    is_unknown_weed = grepl("^UNKNOWN($| )", species),
    component = case_when(
      species %in% c(berseem_codes, rye_codes) ~ "Cover crop",
      species %in% volunteer_codes ~ "Volunteer",
      species %in% weed_species | is_unknown_weed ~ "Weeds",
      TRUE ~ "Unmapped"
    ),
    species_label = case_when(
      species %in% berseem_codes ~ "Berseem clover",
      species %in% rye_codes ~ "Cereal rye",
      species %in% volunteer_codes ~ "Volunteer clover",
      TRUE ~ species
    )
  )

save_csv(
  analysis_records %>%
    distinct(source_species, species, species_label, component),
  "species_classification.csv"
)

# Unknown weeds are included; unfamiliar species codes require checking.
if (any(analysis_records$component == "Unmapped")) {
  save_csv(
    filter(analysis_records, component == "Unmapped"),
    "unmapped_species.csv"
  )
  stop("New species codes found. Check unmapped_species.csv.")
}

save_csv(analysis_records, "clean_T1_T4_records.csv")

save_csv(
  analysis_records %>%
    filter(
      is.na(source_area_m2) |
        abs(source_area_m2 - area_m2) > 1e-10 |
        is.na(source_location) |
        source_location != location
    ),
  "sampling_corrections.csv"
)

save_csv(
  filter(analysis_records, is_unknown_weed),
  "unknown_weed_records.csv"
)

# Avoid combining different collection dates within a quadrat.
date_check <- analysis_records %>%
  group_by(block, treatment, location, quadrat) %>%
  summarise(
    n_dates = n_distinct(collection_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_missing_dates = sum(
      is.na(collection_date) | trimws(collection_date) == ""
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (any(date_check$n_dates != 1L | date_check$n_missing_dates > 0L)) {
  stop("Missing or multiple collection dates within quadrats.")
}

# Aggregate all observed quadrats before selecting biomass components.
quadrat_data <- analysis_records %>%
  group_by(block, treatment, location, quadrat) %>%
  summarise(
    area_m2 = first(area_m2),
    identified_weed_g = sum(
      weight_g[component == "Weeds" & !is_unknown_weed]
    ),
    unknown_weed_g = sum(
      weight_g[component == "Weeds" & is_unknown_weed]
    ),
    volunteer_g = sum(weight_g[component == "Volunteer"]),
    n_cover_crop_records = sum(component == "Cover crop"),
    recorded_cover_crop_g = if (any(component == "Cover crop")) {
      sum(weight_g[component == "Cover crop"])
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    recorded_total_g = sum(weight_g),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    identified_weed_g_m2 = identified_weed_g / area_m2,
    unknown_weed_g_m2 = unknown_weed_g / area_m2,
    volunteer_g_m2 = volunteer_g / area_m2,

    # Include unknown weeds; exclude volunteers and sown cover crops.
    weed_g_m2 = (identified_weed_g + unknown_weed_g) / area_m2,

    recorded_cover_crop_g_m2 = recorded_cover_crop_g / area_m2,
    recorded_total_g_m2 = recorded_total_g / area_m2
  )

# T1: 16 quadrats. T2-T4: 48 quadrats.
expected_quadrats <- bind_rows(
  expand_grid(
    block = 1:4,
    treatment = 1,
    location = "Cover crop",
    quadrat = 1:4
  ),
  expand_grid(
    block = 1:4,
    treatment = 2:4,
    location = locations,
    quadrat = 1:2
  )
)

keys <- c("block", "treatment", "location", "quadrat")

missing_quadrats <- anti_join(
  expected_quadrats,
  quadrat_data,
  by = keys
)

unexpected_quadrats <- anti_join(
  quadrat_data,
  expected_quadrats,
  by = keys
)

save_csv(missing_quadrats, "missing_quadrats.csv")
save_csv(unexpected_quadrats, "unexpected_quadrats.csv")

if (
  nrow(missing_quadrats) > 0 ||
  nrow(unexpected_quadrats) > 0
) {
  stop(
    "Check the quadrat audit files. ",
    "Do not replace missing quadrats with zero."
  )
}

# One mean per experimental plot and sampling location.
plot_data <- quadrat_data %>%
  group_by(block, treatment, location) %>%
  summarise(
    n_quadrats = n(),
    across(
      c(
        identified_weed_g_m2,
        unknown_weed_g_m2,
        volunteer_g_m2,
        weed_g_m2,
        recorded_total_g_m2
      ),
      mean
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    block = factor(
      paste0("B", block),
      levels = paste0("B", 1:4)
    ),
    treatment = factor(
      paste0("T", treatment),
      levels = treatment_levels
    )
  )

if (
  any(
    plot_data$n_quadrats !=
      ifelse(plot_data$treatment == "T1", 4L, 2L)
  )
) {
  stop("Expected four quadrats for T1 and two per location for T2-T4.")
}

save_csv(quadrat_data, "quadrat_biomass_components.csv")
save_csv(plot_data, "plot_biomass_components.csv")

writeLines(
  c(
    paste("Source:", github_url),
    paste(
      "Downloaded at UTC:",
      format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC")
    ),
    paste(
      "Workbook MD5:",
      unname(tools::md5sum(excel_file))
    ),
    "T1: no broccoli or cover crop planted; four 0.16 m2 quadrats per block; cut at 8 cm.",
    "T2: mowing at -1, +3 and +6 weeks relative to transplanting.",
    "T3: mowing at -1 and +6 weeks. T4: mowing at -1 week.",
    "Total weeds include identified and unknown weeds; volunteers and cover crops are excluded.",
    "TRFAL is displayed as Berseem clover; existing CLOVER records remain Volunteer clover.",
    "RYE and CEREAL RYE are sown cover crops. Missing species records are not measured zeros.",
    paste(
      "Recorded cereal-rye rows:",
      sum(analysis_records$species_label == "Cereal rye")
    )
  ),
  file.path(output_dir, "data_source.txt")
)
```

## Sampling checks

T1 has four quadrats per block, sampled at 8 cm above ground.
T2-T4 have two quadrats per plot and sampling location.
Each plot contributes one mean to its location-specific analysis.

```{r sampling-checks}
sampling_check <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(location, treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    Plots = n(),
    Quadrats = sum(n_quadrats),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(sampling_check, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Fit the weed models and prepare figures

```{r models-and-figures, include=FALSE}
fit_tables <- function(d, response) {
  fit <- lm(
    reformulate(c("treatment", "block"), response = response),
    data = d,
    na.action = na.fail
  )

  emm <- emmeans(fit, ~ treatment, weights = "equal")

  list(
    fit = fit,
    anova = make_anova_table(fit),
    means = as.data.frame(
      confint(emm, level = 0.95)
    ),
    tukey = as.data.frame(
      summary(
        pairs(emm, adjust = "tukey"),
        infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),
        level = 0.95
      )
    )
  )
}

analyse_location <- function(location_name) {
  d <- droplevels(
    filter(plot_data, location == location_name)
  )

  expected_n <- if (location_name == "Broccoli") 12L else 16L

  if (
    nrow(d) != expected_n ||
    !all(table(d$block, d$treatment) == 1L)
  ) {
    stop("Expected one plot mean per block-treatment combination.")
  }

  primary <- fit_tables(d, "weed_g_m2")

  log_result <- if (all(d$weed_g_m2 > 0)) {
    fit_tables(
      mutate(d, log_weed = log(weed_g_m2)),
      "log_weed"
    )
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  a <- anova(primary$fit)
  pval <- a["treatment", "Pr(>F)"]

  ptext <- if (pval < 0.001) {
    "<0.001"
  } else {
    paste("=", sprintf("%.3f", pval))
  }

  caption_text <- if (location_name == "Broccoli") {
    paste(
      "T2-T4: cut at ground level; two quadrats per plot.",
      "T1 is reported separately."
    )
  } else {
    paste0(
      "All samples cut at 8 cm. T1: no broccoli or cover crop planted;",
      " four quadrats per plot.\n",
      "T2-T4: two quadrats per plot."
    )
  }

  figure <- ggplot(d, aes(treatment, weed_g_m2)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(colour = treatment, shape = block),
      position = position_jitter(
        width = 0.06,
        height = 0,
        seed = 42
      ),
      size = 2.7
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      data = primary$means,
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      aes(
        x = treatment,
        ymin = emmean - SE,
        ymax = emmean + SE
      ),
      width = 0.12,
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = primary$means,
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      aes(x = treatment, y = emmean),
      shape = 18,
      size = 4
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = treatment_labels) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = treatment_colours) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 15, 3)) +
    expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        "Total weed biomass:",
        location_name,
        "sampling area"
      ),
      subtitle = sprintf(
        "Treatment ANOVA: F(%d, %d) = %.2f; p %s",
        a["treatment", "Df"],
        df.residual(primary$fit),
        a["treatment", "F value"],
        ptext
      ),
      x = "Treatment and mowing weeks relative to transplanting",
      y = expression("Total weed biomass (g " * m^{-2} * ")"),
      shape = "Block",
      caption = paste0(
        caption_text,
        "\nPoints: plots; diamonds: adjusted means;",
        " bars: +/- 1 model-based SE.",
        "\nIncludes identified and unknown weeds;",
        " excludes volunteers and cover crops."
      )
    ) +
    guides(colour = "none") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8)
    )

  prefix <- tolower(gsub(" ", "_", location_name))

  analyses <- list(
    primary = primary,
    log = log_result
  )

  for (nm in names(analyses)) {
    z <- analyses[[nm]]

    if (is.null(z)) next

    for (tab in c("anova", "means", "tukey")) {
      save_csv(
        z[[tab]],
        paste0(prefix, "_weed_", nm, "_", tab, ".csv")
      )
    }
  }

  ggsave(
    file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "_weed_biomass.png")),
    plot = figure,
    width = 8,
    height = 5.5,
    dpi = 600,
    bg = "white"
  )

  ggsave(
    file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "_weed_biomass.pdf")),
    plot = figure,
    width = 8,
    height = 5.5,
    bg = "white"
  )

  list(
    location = location_name,
    primary = primary,
    log = log_result,
    figure = figure
  )
}

results <- setNames(
  lapply(locations, analyse_location),
  locations
)

format_p <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    "",
    ifelse(
      x < 0.001,
      "<0.001",
      sprintf("%.3f", x)
    )
  )
}

report_tables <- function(
  z,
  label,
  include_means = TRUE
) {
  a <- z$anova
  a[["Pr(>F)"]] <- format_p(a[["Pr(>F)"]])

  show_table(
    a,
    paste(label, "- ANOVA"),
    digits = 3
  )

  if (include_means) {
    show_table(
      select(
        z$means,
        treatment,
        emmean,
        SE,
        lower.CL,
        upper.CL
      ),
      paste(
        label,
        "- adjusted means, SEs and individual 95% CIs"
      ),
      digits = 2
    )
  }

  t <- z$tukey %>%
    select(
      contrast,
      estimate,
      SE,
      lower.CL,
      upper.CL,
      p.value
    )

  t$p.value <- format_p(t$p.value)

  show_table(
    t,
    paste(label, "- Tukey-adjusted comparisons"),
    digits = 3
  )
}
```

## Broccoli sampling area: weed biomass

The model compares T2-T4 using samples cut at ground level.
T1 was sampled at 8 cm and is shown separately below as a reference.

```{r broccoli-results, results='asis'}
report_tables(
  results[["Broccoli"]]$primary,
  "Broccoli area"
)

print(results[["Broccoli"]]$figure)
```

### T1 reference: no broccoli or cover crop planted

These are the same T1 plots used in the cover-crop-area analysis.
They are not additional replicates and are not included in the
Broccoli-area ANOVA or its Tukey comparisons.

The summary below is a descriptive mean and SE across four blocks,
not a marginal mean from the Broccoli-area model.

```{r t1-reference}
t1_reference <- plot_data %>%
  filter(treatment == "T1") %>%
  select(
    block,
    n_quadrats,
    weed_g_m2
  )

t1_summary <- t1_reference %>%
  summarise(
    Blocks = n(),
    Mean_g_m2 = mean(weed_g_m2),
    SE_g_m2 = sd(weed_g_m2) / sqrt(n())
  )

knitr::kable(
  t1_reference,
  digits = 2,
  row.names = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(
  t1_summary,
  digits = 2,
  row.names = FALSE
)

save_csv(
  t1_reference,
  "T1_reference_plot_weed_biomass.csv"
)

save_csv(
  t1_summary,
  "T1_reference_descriptive_summary.csv"
)
```

## Cover-crop sampling area: weed biomass

The model compares T1-T4. T1 is the weedy control with no broccoli
or cover crop planted. All included samples were cut at 8 cm.

```{r cover-crop-results, results='asis'}
report_tables(
  results[["Cover crop"]]$primary,
  "Cover-crop area"
)

print(results[["Cover crop"]]$figure)
```

Figure error bars are +/- 1 model-based SE.
The tables retain individual 95% confidence intervals for means
and Tukey-adjusted 95% confidence intervals for pairwise differences.

## Recorded cover-crop biomass

Berseem clover and cereal rye are the sown cover crops. The table below
reports species-specific biomass only where a source record exists.
TRFAL is displayed as Berseem clover; existing CLOVER records are
volunteer clover and are excluded from this table.

Absence of a biomass record alone does not distinguish a true zero from
an unrecorded observation. The table is not an estimate of complete
cover-crop biomass. No cover-crop ANOVA is fitted to these sparse records.

```{r recorded-cover-crop, results='asis'}
cc_records <- analysis_records %>%
  filter(component == "Cover crop") %>%
  group_by(block, treatment, location, quadrat, species_label) %>%
  summarise(
    Area_m2 = first(area_m2),
    Weight_g = sum(weight_g),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    Block = paste0("B", block),
    Treatment = paste0("T", treatment),
    Location = location,
    Quadrat = quadrat,
    Species = species_label,
    Area_m2,
    Weight_g,
    Biomass_g_m2 = Weight_g / Area_m2
  )

if (nrow(cc_records) > 0L) {
  show_table(cc_records, "Recorded sown cover-crop biomass", digits = 3)
} else {
  cat("No sown cover-crop biomass records were found in this workbook.\n\n")
}

if (!any(analysis_records$species_label == "Cereal rye")) {
  cat("No cereal-rye biomass records were found in this workbook.\n\n")
}

save_csv(cc_records, "recorded_cover_crop_biomass.csv")
```

## Volunteer clover and unknown weeds

Volunteer clover is reported separately and excluded from total weed
biomass. Unknown weeds are shown as a subset of total weed biomass;
they are already included in the primary analysis above.

```{r other-components}
other_summary <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(location, treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    Blocks = n(),
    Volunteer_clover_g_m2 = mean(volunteer_g_m2),
    Unknown_weeds_g_m2 = mean(unknown_weed_g_m2),
    Total_weeds_g_m2 = mean(weed_g_m2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(
  other_summary,
  digits = 2,
  row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Volunteer clover, unknown weeds and total weeds: plot-based means"
)

save_csv(other_summary, "volunteer_and_unknown_weed_summary.csv")
```

## Model diagnostics

Inspect residual spread, normal Q-Q plots and influential observations
before interpreting the primary models. Shapiro-Wilk tests are
supplementary and do not establish that all model assumptions hold.

```{r diagnostics, fig.height=6}
for (loc in locations) {
  old_par <- par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

  plot(
    results[[loc]]$primary$fit,
    which = c(1, 2, 3, 5),
    ask = FALSE
  )

  par(old_par)
}
```

```{r normality-tests}
normality_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(locations, function(loc) {
    test <- shapiro.test(
      residuals(results[[loc]]$primary$fit)
    )

    data.frame(
      Location = loc,
      W = unname(test$statistic),
      p_value = test$p.value
    )
  })
)

knitr::kable(
  normality_results,
  digits = 4,
  row.names = FALSE
)

save_csv(
  normality_results,
  "weed_residual_normality.csv"
)
```

## Log-scale sensitivity analysis

A separate analysis of natural-log weed biomass is run only when
all plot responses are positive. No constant is added to zeros.
Estimates in these tables are on the natural-log scale.

```{r log-sensitivity, results='asis'}
for (loc in locations) {
  cat("\n\n### ", loc, "\n\n", sep = "")

  z <- results[[loc]]$log

  if (is.null(z)) {
    cat(
      "Log analysis skipped because a plot response was zero.\n\n"
    )
  } else {
    report_tables(
      z,
      paste(
        loc,
        "- natural-log weed biomass"
      ),
      include_means = FALSE
    )
  }
}
```

## Interpretation

Primary results concern total recorded weed biomass, including both
identified and unknown weeds. Volunteer clover, berseem clover and
cereal rye are excluded from this response.

T1-T4 comparisons in the cover-crop area include the no-crop control;
T2-T4 comparisons in the broccoli area concern mowing schedules.
Differences from T1 cannot be attributed to mowing alone because
planting also differs.

The two sampling protocols are interpreted separately.
A nonsignificant test does not demonstrate treatment equivalence.

Conclusions should consider effect estimates, uncertainty, diagnostics
and the log-scale sensitivity analysis. The cover-crop table reports
recorded species-specific biomass; it does not establish complete
berseem-plus-rye biomass or its treatment response.
